name: Sithchenn

attributes.attribute: Irish hero who was a druid and a smith
of the Nine Hostages, chose the anvil
iron sign that Niall would rule from Tara

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sithchenn is an Irish hero. He is named a druid and a smith. Niall of the Nine Hostages and his four brothers asked Sithchenn to give them their future. He set fire to his own forge. Then he watched what each youth took as he ran from the burning roof. Niall carried out the anvil, the smith's most valued tool. Sithchenn saw this and declared that Niall would one day lead all of Ireland. Niall would sit on the great royal seat of Tara. The anvil was the prized iron of the trade, and the one who bore it would hold the land of the island. The other brothers lost the prize. The fire named the man who would be king from the tool he chose to save first.
